examples.arabic: ذهبت الى السوق الكبير لاشتري ملابس جديدة للصيف
examples.english: I went to the large market to buy new clothes for the summer.
examples.transliteration: dhahabtu ila al suq al kabir li ashtari malabis jadida lil sayf

examples.arabic: في المساء امشي في السوق الجميل واشم رائحة القهوة
examples.english: In the evening I walk in the beautiful market and smell the coffee.
examples.transliteration: fi al-masa amshi fi as-suq al-jamil wa-ashummu raihat al-qahwa.

examples.arabic: يذهب خالد الى السوق في المساء
examples.english: Khalid goes to the market in the evening.
examples.transliteration: Yadhhabu khalid ila as suq fi al masa

examples.arabic: انا ازور السوق كل صباح واشتري الورد
examples.english: I visit the market every morning and buy flowers
examples.transliteration: Ana azur as suq kulla sabah wa ashtari al ward

examples.arabic: اذهب الى السوق مع عائلتي لشراء ملابس
examples.english: I go to the market with my family to buy clothes.
examples.transliteration: adhhab ila alsouq ma'a aa'ilatee lishiraa malaabis

examples.arabic: ذهب الجد مع حفيده الى السوق الكبير اليوم
examples.english: The grandfather went with his grandson to the big market today.
examples.transliteration: Dhahaba al-jadd ma'a hafidihi ila as-suqi al-kabiri al-yawm.
